chapter.v:
“Hold a
holy meeting on the first day of the seventh month. Don't do any of your normal work. This is the day when you will blow the trumpets.

Present a
burnt offering of one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all of them without defects, as a sacrifice acceptable to the Lord,

along with
their grain offerings of the best flour mixed with olive oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths of an ephah for the ram,

and one
tenth of an ephah for each of the seven male lambs.

Also present
a male goat as a sin offering to make you right.

These offerings
are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings along with their required grain offerings and drink offerings. They are burnt offerings acceptable to the Lord.

Hold a
holy meeting on the tenth day of this seventh month, and practice self-denial. Don't do any of your normal work.

Present a
burnt offering of one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all of them without defects, acceptable to the Lord.

They are
to be accompanied by their grain offerings of the best flour mixed with olive oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths of an ephah for the ram,

and one
tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs.

Also present
a male goat as a sin offering in addition to the sin offering to make you right and the continual burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

Hold a
holy meeting on the fifteenth day of the seventh month. Don't do any of your normal work. You are to celebrate a festival dedicated to the Lord for seven days.

Present the
following as a burnt offering acceptable to the Lord: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all of them without defects.

They are
to be accompanied by their grain offerings of the best flour mixed with olive oil: three-tenths of an ephah of the best flour mixed with olive oil for each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths of an ephah for each of the two rams,

and one
tenth of an ephah for each of the fourteen lambs.

Also present
a male goat as a sin offering in addition to the continual burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

On the
second day present twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all of them without defects.

They are
to be accompanied by their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, all according to the number required.

Also present
a male goat as a sin offering in addition to the continual burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

On the
third day present eleven young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all of them without defects.

They are
to be accompanied by their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, all according to the number required.

Also present
a male goat as a sin offering in addition to the continual burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

On the
fourth day present ten young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all of them without defects.

They are
to be accompanied by their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, all according to the number required.

Also present
a male goat as a sin offering in addition to the continual burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

On the
fifth day present nine young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all of them without defects.

They are
to be accompanied by their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, all according to the number required.

Also present
a male goat as a sin offering in addition to the continual burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

On the
sixth day present eight young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all of them without defects.

They are
to be accompanied by their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, all according to the number required.

Also present
a male goat as a sin offering in addition to the continual burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

On the
seventh day present seven young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all of them without defects.

They are
to be accompanied by their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, all according to the number required.

Also present
a male goat as a sin offering in addition to the continual burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

On the
eighth day all of you are to meet together. Don't do any of your normal work.

Present the
following as a burnt offering acceptable to the Lord: one bull, two rams, and seven male lambs a year old, all of them without defects.

They are
to be accompanied by their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, all according to the number required.

Also present
a male goat as a sin offering in addition to the continual burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

Present these
offerings to the Lord at the times you are required to do so, in addition to your offerings to fulfill a promise and freewill offerings, whether they are burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, or peace offerings.”

Moses repeated
all this to the Israelites as the Lord ordered him to do.
